name: Anandu
reason: ānandu/आनन्दु agree; Malayali form of Ānanda, joy; fine for a boy

name: Sudheesh
reason: sudhī+īśa=sudhīśa, sandhi correct; IAST and Devanagari agree; lord of the wise

name: Madhusmita
reason: madhu+smitā, sweet smile; scripts agree; suitable girl's name

name: Rashmita
reason: raśmitā is acceptable as a modern name but the 'possessing rays' -itā gloss is not sound Sanskrit; meaning softened

fix.name: Rashmita
fix.meaning_en: Radiant, ray-like (from raśmi, ray of light); modern name, etymology uncertain

name: Itishree
reason: negative_meaning: itiśrī is the colophon 'thus ends', i.e. finish/end, not auspicious as a name

name: Bibhuti
reason: vibhūti/विभूति agree; glory, might, sacred ash; established Bengali boy's name

name: Nilamadhab
reason: nīla+mādhava, Jagannath epithet; scripts agree; no ē/ō/f

name: Lalatendu
reason: lalāṭa+indu=lalāṭendu, a+i to e sandhi correct; Shiva epithet, moon on the forehead
